h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bettiah

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bettiah

items.pText: Bettiah is the headquarters of West Champaran in north-west Bihar, a district of farmland and forest that runs up to the Nepal border and the Valmiki Tiger Reserve. Its schools and residential colonies are surrounded by green fields, and many school managements want a playground that feels part of that setting. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment at our Vasai factory, about 1,440 km away, and sends it by road to Bettiah.

Our design team has created a collection of play stations based on shapes from nature, such as trees, flowers and animals. Children in a town close to forests and fields recognise these forms straight away. The structures are built from the same galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts as our other ranges, with the same warranty. A school can pair one nature-themed station with simple swings and a see-saw, and keep the budget under control.

items.q: Do you make nature-themed playground equipment?
items.a: Yes. Our Funplay Originals range includes Nature Sparsh and Organic Play, designed by our own team around shapes from nature. They use the same materials and warranty as our standard range.

items.q: Can you install a playground on a bare soil school ground?
items.a: Yes. We suggest levelling and slightly raising the area first, then laying rubber flooring under the equipment. Posts are grouted into concrete so they stay firm on soft soil.

items.q: Do you deliver playground equipment to West Champaran?
items.a: Yes. Equipment made in Vasai is sent to Bettiah by road and installed by our team or a dealer serving Bihar.
